name: Sacred Heart and St Anne, Blackburn

boundary.description: From the point where Ribble Valley – Blackburn District boundary crosses Lammack Road, S along Lammack Road, to the bend in Lammack Road near West Leigh Road, and by a beeline to and along Paignton Road, W along Revidge Road and S along Brantfell Road, SW along East Park Road. East along Preston New Road and Barbara Castle Way. By a beeline S to and along Ainsworth Street, then W along Church Street, Higher Church Street, NW along Astley Gate, King Street, Whalley Banks and Bank Top. Then N along Garden Street, W along Wensley Road, to its junction with Buncer Lane, then N along Buncer Lane to its junction with Billinge Avenue (both sides in Sacred Heart & St Anne parish) and SW by a beeline to south end of Lawley Road (both sides in Sacred Heart & St Anne parish). N by Lawley Road, W by Under Billinge Lane and N following W boundary of Billinge Wood to and along Killiard Lane and Billinge End Road. Then by a beeline N to and along W boundary of Westholme Senior School and Sixth Form, continuing N to and E along Ribble Valley - Blackburn District boundary (near, but excluding Arley Farm) to its crossing with Lammack Road.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between Sacred Heart and St Anne
internalBoundaries.description: West along Preston New Road, NW along Crosshill Road and by a bee-line to the junction of Wensley Road and Buncer Lane.
